mechanics.claim: Casting a basic ability puts Udyr's other basic abilities on a brief shared global cooldown.
mechanics.quote: incur a {{sti|cd|{{tt|{{fd|1.5}}-second global cooldown|Affected by ability haste}}}} when cast

mechanics.claim: The global cooldown does not apply to abilities already on a longer individual cooldown.
mechanics.quote: The global cooldown will not incur on abilities that are currently on a greater cooldown.

mechanics.claim: Awakened Spirit's cooldown is affected by ultimate haste, not regular ability haste.
mechanics.quote: ''Awakened Spirit's'' cooldown is affected by {{sti|ah|icononly=true}} {{as|ultimate haste|ah}}.

mechanics.claim: Switching stances does not end the effects granted by the previous stance's Monk Training proc early.
mechanics.quote: Switching ''Stances'' will not cause any additional effects granted by the previous one to end prematurely.

mechanics.claim: Monk Training's empowered attacks apply on-hit and grant attack speed for the next two basic attacks after casting any ability.
mechanics.quote: empowers his next two {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} within 4 seconds to gain {{sti|{{as|30% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}

mechanics.claim: The cooldown refund from Monk Training does not occur if Awakened Spirit's remaining cooldown is under 1 second.
mechanics.quote: though not if the remaining cooldown is less than 1 second

mechanics.claim: An Awaken cast also triggers Monk Training and empowers the next two attacks with the stance's unawakened on-hit effect as well.
mechanics.quote: ''Awakened Spirit's'' cast also activates ''Monk Training'' and empowers the next 2 attacks by the stances unawakened effects as well, overriding unused unawakened stance attacks.

mechanics.claim: Empowered attacks are not consumed if they are parried.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attacks will not get consumed if they are parried.

mechanics.claim: Awakened Spirit is on full cooldown at game start.
mechanics.quote: ''Awakened Spirit'' is placed on full cooldown at the start of the game.
